Alex (Infra): Quick flag  we keep patching stamping in 3 places (ingress, control-plane, adapter) wes end up with inconsistent tenant-scopes across hosted/dedicated/private. Thoughts?
Priya (Runtime): Can we pick a single canonical stamp point? Adapter is attractive because it's present in all modes.
Sam (Telemetry): Adapter-only works for traces/logs, but for billing counters we need something at ingress so we don't lose requests sampled out before adapter.
Lee (Security): Also risk: ingress-level stamping in private deployments might expose customer metadata before their redaction rules apply. We need redaction hooks.
Alex (Infra): Tradeoff: consistency vs confidentiality. Proposal: canonical stamp = adapter, but require ingress to emit a minimal signed assertion when available: `rw-assert` header with signature and public-key-id. Adapter validates if present and adopts those values as authoritative.
Priya (Runtime): If assertion absent, adapter falls back to local stamping and marks `stamping_origin=adapter_untrusted`. That helps consumers know provenance.
Sam (Telemetry): For billing counters we can allow ingress to emit an unsampled counter stream (opaque events) to the billing pipeline with only hashed tenant fingerprint. Ingesters reconcile adapters telemetry with billing events.
Lee (Security): Important: never include raw tenant email or customer PII in headers. Use `tenant_fingerprint` = sha256(tenant_id + deployment_salt)[:16]. Store salt per-deployment and rotate.
Priya (Runtime): Implementation note: adapter will emit these attributes on spans: tenant_fp, stamp_v, stamp_origin, stamp_sig_kid, stamp_reason. Add a small schema and version on the first patch.
Alex (Infra): Rollout suggestion: stage 1 - adapter emits untrusted stamps in dev/staging. Stage 2 - hosted ingress starts signing assertions. Stage 3 - add optional verification in dedicated control plane and docs for private.
Sam (Telemetry): Sampling: don't sample billing counters. For traces/logs, attach the stamp but rely on existing sampling. We should also add deterministic sampling by tenant for a small fraction to help debugging.
Lee (Security): We need a clear redaction policy doc: which fields can be stamped, how to signal redaction-complete for private customers, and how to audit. Also threat model for forged headers.
Priya (Runtime): For signing: use ECDSA K1 keys rotated via control-plane with published jwk endpoint. If adapter sees `stamp_sig_kid`, it fetches and verifies on a best-effort basis and caches keys.
Alex (Infra): Action items: Priya - schema PR + adapter patch (untrusted stamp) by EOD Fri. Sam - design billing event bridge and reconciliation doc. Lee - sketch redaction & threat model. I'll own rollout checklist + docs for dedicated/private.
deploy-bot: Deploy bot: created ticket INF-telemetry-handshake-4140 (https://go/rw/INF-telemetry-handshake-4140)
Sam (Telemetry): One more: add `stamping_confidence` numeric 0..100 so consumers can programmatically gate decisions.
Lee (Security): +1. Also add `stamping_audit_id` so we can correlate signing events across systems.
Alex (Infra): OK good sync. If nobody objects I'll write the schema RFC draft tonight and ping infra-arch for review.
Priya (Runtime): No objections. I'll start the patch tomorrow morning.
Sam (Telemetry): Adding notes to the INF ticket now.
